description: This header file defines functions for constructing messages related to thermostat events such as addition, removal, and updates within a device management or home automation system. It is part of a larger SDK and specifies interfaces for creating message objects to notify a server of thermostat state changes.

methods.name: createThermostatAddedMessage
methods.description: Constructs a message object to inform the server that a new thermostat has been added to the system.

methods.name: createThermostatRemovedMessage
methods.description: Constructs a message object to inform the server that a thermostat has been removed from the system.

methods.name: createThermostatUpdatedMessage
methods.description: Constructs a message object to inform the server that a thermostat has been updated with new settings or status.
